searchSchema.description: TempMaster packaged heat pump rooftop units (3-25 ton). Enter design loads and the page returns models that meet the targets within your tolerance.

notes: Provide with factory installed refrigerant detection system (RDS) as required for R-454B.
Provide with economizer with enthalpy sensor
Provide with factory installed, field powered 115V GFCI outlet
Provide with factory installed DDC controller with BAS input and 7-day programmable thermostat
